title: Grading Card Companies Near Me (2026)
verdict: Grading card companies near me are scarce outside a few cities, and AGS covers the gap with mail-in grading at $18 and a return in 20 business days or less.
Be careful with any shop or kiosk that claims to grade on the spot. Ask whose slab the card comes back in. If it is not a grader buyers recognize, the grade will not help you sell.

sections.h: Four ways to get cards graded locally
list: Drop them off. AGS accepts in-person drop-offs at select locations, including secure intake at its headquarters at 727 Page Ave, Staten Island, New York. Confirm with AGS first.
Use a card shop. The shop ships your cards to a grading company and adds a handling fee. Ask which grader, which tier and the full price.
Mail them to a grader yourself. This is how most cards are graded. AGS returns standard orders in 20 business days or less.
Go to a card show. Large shows often have graders accepting submissions, and some grade on site at premium prices.
Confirm with AGS that the location is taking drop-offs and when.
Fill out the submission form online first.
Bring the cards in penny sleeves and card savers, in the order listed on the form.
Keep your order number. You can follow the order in the dashboard afterward.

ranking.note: Submit online first, then ship or drop off. The dashboard shows the order status, and you pay when grading is done.

why: AGS is one of the few graders you can hand cards to. It accepts drop-offs at select AGS locations, including secure intake at its Staten Island headquarters, and its scanner is compact enough to grade on site. Message AGS before you travel to confirm where intake is open.
Nothing is locked in. No minimum order, no membership, no contract, and payment is taken when the cards are graded. A first order gets 20% off with code AGSNEW20.

There is no value upcharge. A $20 card and a $20,000 card cost the same $18 to grade at AGS, and bulk orders of 30 or more start at $15. Subgrades and the report are included, where Beckett charges $3 more for subgrades at its Base tier.

faq.q: Are there grading card companies near me?
faq.a: Grading is done in central labs, so near me usually means by mail. AGS returns mail-in orders in 20 business days or less and takes in-person drop-offs at select locations.

faq.q: Is there a card grading company near me?
faq.a: Probably not one that grades on site. Almost every grader works by mail from one or two labs. A local card shop that offers grading is usually forwarding cards to one of them for a fee.

faq.q: Is AGS a legitimate grading company?
faq.a: Yes. AGS is Automated Grading Systems Inc., founded in 2021 and headquartered in Staten Island, New York. It publishes a live population report and a cert lookup, and says it ranked third in TCG grading volume in 2026.

faq.q: How should I pack cards for grading?
faq.a: Put each card in a new penny sleeve, then a semi-rigid card saver. Sandwich the stack between cardboard, wrap it in bubble wrap and box it. Top loaders are allowed, but card savers travel better.

faq.q: Can I get a card graded the same day?
faq.a: AGS says same-day grading is available for urgent submissions. Contact AGS before you ship or drop off to arrange it. Elsewhere, the quickest posted tiers are 2 to 5 business days and cost $50 to $150 a card.
